PARAM.name: Match type
PARAM.DESCRIPTION: Type of match which created this table

PARAM.name: Match algorithm
PARAM.DESCRIPTION: Matching algorithm which created this table

PARAM.name: Join Type
PARAM.value: All from 1 (An output row for each matched or unmatched row in table 1 (LEFT OUTER JOIN))
PARAM.DESCRIPTION: Determines which rows appear in output table

FIELD.name: GalaxyName
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Galaxy name

FIELD.name: RA
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Right Ascension (hours minutes seconds)

FIELD.name: Dec
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Declination (degrees arcminutes arcseconds)

FIELD.name: EB-V
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Foreground reddening, E(B-V), measured directly from the Schlegel et al 1998 maps (they do not include the recalibration by Schlafly & Finbiener 2011)

FIELD.name: dmod
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Distance Modulus, (m-M)o err+ err-

FIELD.name: vh
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Heliocentric radial velocity, vh(km/s) err+ err-

FIELD.name: Vmag
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Apparent V magnitude in Vega mags, Vmag err+ err-

FIELD.name: PA
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Position Angle of major axis in degrees measured east from north, PA err+ err-

FIELD.name: e=1-b/a
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Projected ellipticity, e=1-b/a err+ err-

FIELD.name: muVo
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Central V surface brightness, muVo(mag/sq.arcsec) err+ err-

FIELD.name: rh
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Half-light radius measured on major axis, rh(arcmins) err+ err-

FIELD.name: sigma_s
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Stellar radial velocity dispersion, sigma_s(km/s) err+ err-

FIELD.name: sigma_s-
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Stellar peak/max rotation velocity, vrot_s(km/s) err+ err-

FIELD.name: MHI
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Mass of HI (calculated for the adopted distance modulus), M_HI (10^6M_sun)

FIELD.name: sigma_g
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: HI radial velocity dispersion, sigma_g(km/s) err+ err-

FIELD.name: vrot_g
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: HI peak/max rotation velocity, vrot_g(km/s) err+ err-

FIELD.name: [Fe/H]
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Stellar mean metallicity in dex, [Fe/H] err+ err-

FIELD.name: F
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Flag, F, for technique used to measure metallicity: 1=High res. spectroscopy; 2=Spectral synthesis; 3=CaT calibration; 4=CMD modelling; 5=Isochrones; 6=color of red giant branch

FIELD.name: pmra
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: mu_alpha*cos(delta) - proper motion in RA direction in mas/yr, +err, -err

FIELD.name: pmdec
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: mu_delta - proper motion in declination direction in mas/yr, +err, -err

FIELD.name: References
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: References, numbers refer to list given in supplementary file "References.dat"
